Created **[`spec/evaluation-strategy.md`](spec/evaluation-strategy.md)** (draft). Step 2 (syncing `spec/`, `rules/`, `commands/`) is left for a follow-up as you asked.

### What the spec contains

| Area | Sections |
|------|----------|
| **Context** | PDF learning goals, FEAT-22, split from deterministic testing ([`requirements.md`](spec/requirements.md) §2.5) |
| **Retrieval quality — what / why / how** | §4 — ticket-id–based usefulness in top-K; why it’s separate from grounding; manual seeded procedure; what JUnit still covers |
| **Corpus & PDF questions** | §5 — mirrors §4.3 Example table; five illustrative questions with **required** vs **optional** ticket ids; Flow E negatives |
| **Worked examples** | §5.3 — good/poor retrieval, citation drops, threshold false-empty |
| **Procedure & evidence** | §6–§7 — when to re-run; how to get retrieved ids (logs, doubles, debug — aligned with [`commands/review-rag-output.md`](commands/review-rag-output.md)) |
| **Failures & detection** | §8 — taxonomy F-01…F-10, detection matrix, escalation |
| **Recording & ACs** | §9 eval log; **AC-EVAL-01…05**; traceability §11 |

### Design choices (aligned with existing repo)

- **Grounding** stays in `commands/review-rag-output.md`; this file owns **retrieval quality** and failure taxonomy.
- **No golden LLM strings** in unit tests (`rules/testing.md`, [`test-strategy.md`](spec/test-strategy.md)).
- **No invented** top-K/threshold/model numbers — pointers to [`rag-ingestion.md`](spec/rag-ingestion.md) / **DEC-09**.

### Step 2 (when you want it)

Likely touch-ups:

- [`rules/documentation.md`](rules/documentation.md) — reviewer section map for `evaluation-strategy.md` (like other specs).
- [`commands/review-rag-output.md`](commands/review-rag-output.md) — trim duplication now that §5–§8 exist here.
- [`spec/requirements.md`](spec/requirements.md) §0.4 — confirm §5 pointer (already references eval §5).
- Optional: [`docs/assessment-brief.md`](docs/assessment-brief.md) one-line “present” confirmation.

Say when to run step 2 and whether you want a focused pass (docs only) or full cross-link + `review-spec` alignment.
